title: Revealing the dynamic network structure of the Beck Depression Inventory-II
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Limited to clinical population; - No person-specific network analysis; - No formal test for redundancy/conceptual overlap; - No mention of data availability or code availability in the paper.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly declared in the paper, but may be available through the authors or supplementary materials. The study used paper-and-pencil administration, not digital devices.
